grades.reason: Describes SFENCE.VMA ordering and TLB invalidation semantics. It says nothing about what makes an Sv39 leaf a superpage or about page alignment.

grades.quote: Any level of PTE may be a leaf PTE, so in addition to 4 KiB pages, Sv39 supports 2 MiB _megapages_ and 1 GiB _gigapages_ , each of which must be virtually and physically aligned to a boundary equal to its size. A page-fault exception is raised if the physical address is insufficiently aligned.
grades.reason: Directly answers the question for Sv39. A leaf PTE can sit at any level, so a higher-level leaf maps a 2 MiB megapage or 1 GiB gigapage. Each must be virtually and physically aligned to its own size, and a misaligned physical address raises a page fault.

grades.quote: each of which must be virtually and physically aligned to a boundary equal to its size. A page-fault exception is raised if the physical address is insufficiently aligned.
grades.reason: This passage covers Sv57, not Sv39. It states the same leaf-at-any-level and size-alignment rule, so it is only auxiliary. It does not give the Sv39 page sizes, though it does mention Sv39 in passing.
